description: This header defines helper functions for sending and receiving file descriptors over Unix domain sockets using the cmsg(3) API. It includes functions to facilitate transferring file descriptors and data, with attention to proper message formatting and safety checks. The code also contains explanatory comments about common pitfalls and best practices for working with Unix socket control messages.

methods.name: SendFileDescriptorVector
methods.description: Sends data along with a vector of file descriptors over a Unix domain socket.

methods.name: ReceiveFileDescriptorVector
methods.description: Receives data and file descriptors from a Unix domain socket, with checks for expected number of FDs.

methods.name: ssize_t SendFileDescriptors(borrowed_fd sock,const void * data,size_t len,Args &&...sent_fds)
methods.description: Template helper that constructs a vector of file descriptors and sends them along with data.

methods.name: ssize_t ReceiveFileDescriptors(borrowed_fd sock,void * data,size_t len,Args &&...received_fds)
methods.description: Template helper that receives data and a specified number of file descriptors, handling cleanup on errors.

search-terms: unix domain socket file descriptor passing
